privacy_meta_description: Privacy policy and data handling for mxwatch.
privacy_s1_body: At mxwatch, we prioritize your privacy. We do not collect personally identifiable information (PII) from our users. We do not require registration or accounts to access the main map functionality.
privacy_s2_body: We use privacy-respecting analytics tools to understand in an aggregated and anonymous way how the platform is used. This helps us improve performance and the user experience without tracking individual identities or collecting sensitive data.
privacy_s3_body: We may use your browser's local storage to save display preferences (such as the map state or themes). These tools are not used to track your activity outside this site.
privacy_s4_body: Our platform may contain links to other sites of interest or data sources. Once you use these links to leave our site, you should note that we have no control over that other website and are not responsible for the protection and privacy of any information you provide.
privacy_s5_body: We are committed to ensuring that your information is secure. To prevent unauthorized access or disclosure, we have put in place physical, electronic, and administrative procedures to safeguard and secure the information we collect online.
privacy_footer: Privacy is a right, not a privilege. Thank you for trusting mxwatch.
